instruction: i want to cancel the order i placed yesterday
response: I can help with that. Please share the order number from your confirmation email and tell me whether it has shipped yet, and I will explain the cancellation steps that apply to it.

instruction: where is my order right now
response: Share the order number and I will point you to its current tracking status. If the tracking link has not updated yet, that usually means the carrier has not scanned the parcel, and I can raise it for you.

instruction: how do i get my money back for a damaged item
response: I am sorry the item arrived damaged. Send me the order number and a photo of the damage, and I will start a refund request. The timeline depends on the refund policy that applies to your order, so I will confirm it before promising a date.

instruction: my refund has not arrived yet what is happening
response: Let me check. Please give me the order number and the date the refund was approved. Refunds usually appear on the original payment method, and your bank may take a few working days to post it once it is released.

instruction: i cannot sign in because i forgot my password
response: Use the password reset link on the sign-in page and follow the email that arrives. If it does not appear, check the spam folder. Never share your password with anyone, including support.

instruction: how do i open a new account with you
response: Choose the sign-up option on the home page, enter an email address you can access, and confirm the verification message. Tell me if the verification email does not arrive and I will look into it.

I can start that for you. Deleting the account removes access to order history, so confirm you want to continue, and tell me the email address on the account so I can verify it before anything is removed.

instruction: i need to change the email address on my profile
response: Open the profile settings and edit the email field, then confirm the message sent to the new address. If you cannot sign in to reach settings, tell me and I will suggest another way to verify you.

instruction: my card was declined when i tried to pay
response: That usually comes from the bank rather than the store. Try a different card or payment method, and check whether your bank blocked the attempt. Do not send me your full card number at any point.

instruction: which ways can i pay for an order
response: The available payment methods are listed on the checkout page for your region. Tell me which country you are ordering from and I will point you to the exact list rather than guessing.

instruction: i need a copy of the invoice for my last order
response: You can download the invoice from the order details page in your account. Send me the order number if the download option is missing and I will look at what is available for that order.

instruction: can you send me the invoice by email
response: I can request it. Confirm the order number and the email address it should go to, and I will arrange for the invoice to be sent there.

instruction: i moved and need to change the delivery address
response: Address changes are possible while the order has not shipped. Send me the order number and the new address, and I will check whether it can still be updated.

instruction: how long will my delivery take to arrive
response: Delivery time depends on the shipping option chosen and the destination. Give me the order number and I will read back the estimate shown for it instead of quoting a general figure.

instruction: i want to complain about the service i received
response: I am sorry about your experience and I want to get it recorded properly. Tell me what happened and the order number if it involves one, and I will raise a complaint with the details you give me.

instruction: i would like to talk to a real person
response: I can pass you to a human colleague. Tell me briefly what the issue is so I can include it in the handover, and let me know whether chat or a call suits you better.
